title: bookings' price list is kept in euros, as the venue's price sheet writes it, and renamed SEAT_NIGHT_EUROS to say so
covers: a provider changes a file outside its interface
a user reaches that file with import(), which rule 28's check does not look at
note: front's priceMenu takes SEAT_NIGHT_CENTS out of the module it imports: it is undefined, the menu rejects with a TypeError, and front's price menu test fails.
